card.name: Linking words in stock label phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, and, as) inside fixed phrases: 'inspected visually for particulate matter', 'Warnings and Precautions', and 'Cite this publication as'.

modes.label: Inspect for particulates
modes.description: The word 'for' after 'inspected' or 'parenteral drug products' in visual-inspection instructions.
modes.example: Visually inspect parenteral drug products<< for>> particulate matter and discoloration prior

modes.label: Warnings and Precautions
modes.description: The word 'and' between 'Warnings' and 'Precautions' in section cross-references.
modes.example: see Contraindications (4) and Warnings<< and>> Precautions (5.1)

modes.label: Cite this publication as
modes.description: The word 'as' after 'Cite this publication' in a citation line.

card.writes: It suppresses 'only' and 'exclusively', so it keeps the model from inserting those words after the linking word.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in set label phrases, such as 'inspect for particulate matter' and 'Warnings and Precautions'.
